title: Price lists
description: Published prices per presentation, and the supplier import that feeds them.
branchRequired: Pick a branch in the top bar to view and edit price lists.

errors.unexpectedCreateDefault: Unexpected error creating the default price list.
errors.unexpectedSaveMapping: Unexpected error saving the supplier mapping.

empty.noMatch: No price lists match this search.
empty.loadError: The price lists could not be loaded.

editor.empty: There are no products in the catalog yet.

remark.label: Remark %
remark.hint: Applies to the base price of the selected rows or, when none is selected, of every visible row. Review the preview before publishing.

errors.invalidPrice: Enter a price greater than zero, with up to two decimals.
errors.belowFloor: No price was published: some prices are below their floor list. Fix the marked rows.
errors.unexpectedLoad: Unexpected error while loading the prices.
errors.unexpectedPublish: Unexpected error while publishing the prices.

discard.title: Unpublished changes
discard.message_one: You have {{count}} unpublished change. Discard it?
discard.message_other: You have {{count}} unpublished changes. Discard them?

suppliersPlaceholder: Supplier mappings (column mapping for Excel imports) land here in a future release — the `supplier_price_mappings` table does not exist yet.

createMapping.explanation: No supplier mapping exists yet — configure one before importing.

breakdown.title: Composition of {{name}}
breakdown.description: How each price is built: the base price plus each component.
breakdown.empty: No products have a price on this date.
breakdown.noComposition: No composition: the final price is the base price.
breakdown.floorHint: This list can never go below its floor, product by product.
breakdown.historyEmpty: There are no earlier versions yet.

errors.floorCycle: That list already depends on this one: the floor would form a cycle.
errors.unexpectedFloor: Unexpected error changing the floor list.

compositionForm.title: Edit composition of {{name}}
compositionForm.description: Publishes a new version from the chosen date; earlier versions stay in the history.
compositionForm.effectiveFromHint: Tomorrow by default. The current version is not edited: a new one is published and the history is kept.
compositionForm.markupHint: Changes only the markup; the other components stay as they are.
compositionForm.label: Label {{index}}

errors.dateTaken: A composition with that effective date already exists. Pick another date.
errors.incomplete: Fill in the label, code and percentage of every component.

copyForm.title: Copy {{name}}
copyForm.description: Creates a new list with this list's base prices and its composition with a different markup. The source list does not change.
copyForm.name: New list name
copyForm.markupHint: Replaces the markup of the copied composition.

errors.nameTaken: A list with that name already exists.
errors.invalid: Check the name and the markup.

violations.title: These products would fall below {{floor}}
violations.hint: Nothing was saved. Raise those prices or the markup and try again.
